title: Run acceptance test for Azure Blob remote corpus
description: Acceptance test: use Azure Blob container with ~10 MP3s, configure remote corpus source, run source pull, then build an STT extraction snapshot via an information pipeline recipe to verify text extraction from all 10 items.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Task created and set In Progress. Acceptance plan: configure azure_storage.connection_string in ~/.biblicus/config.yml (or AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING env var), set corpus metadata/config.json source kind azure-blob + container, then run source pull and build STT extraction snapshot for ~10 MP3s.
